summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an option agreement to acquire seven California real estate LLCs (147 units, portfolio value $125.5M, equity value $69.5M). The option is exclusive, irrevocable for six months from June 4, 2026. Consideration includes option fees payable in common stock or Series C preferred stock, with cash election at the company's discretion. No board recommendation or advisor named. Mechanics involve non-convertible preferred stock. This is an option to acquire, not a definitive acquisition, and no target role is assigned. The filing is a material definitive agreement but does not constitute a completed special situation transaction; thus, 'None' is appropriate.
